hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook that bypasses AMM pricing by implementing a custom constant-price curve via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. On each swap it takes the input from the PoolManager, calls phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw() to convert tokens, and settles the output. Liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.
